beats.text: Seconds one to three. This is where you decide: swipe, or stay.
Seconds four to seven. The hook is done. Now the video has to pay off, or you're gone too.
Tests for Facebook found people remember a feed post after a quarter of a second.
And up to forty-seven percent of a video ad's impact lands in the first three seconds.
The median YouTube Short is watched about forty-five percent through. That point is already behind you.
Instagram says watch time is one of its top three ranking signals. So by staying, you just voted for this video.
The other two? Likes and sends. You know what to do.

sources: Fors Marsh tests for Facebook (2016, via AdAge/ITWeb): feed content recalled after 0.25 s; mobile content consumed in 1.7 s vs 2.5 s desktop. Facebook/Nielsen: up to 47% of a video campaign's value in first 3 s, 74% by 10 s (via Smart Insights). quso.ai Shorts benchmark: median average view-through ~45% (508K Shorts). Adam Mosseri, Jan 2025: top three ranking signals are watch time, likes and sends (Social Media Today). Retention curve in video = schematic.
